title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap record and the Microsoft documentation checked. Both API calls are documented, including the allocation request body, and the page distinguishes prepaid controls from pay-as-you-go spending. Searches did not identify a documented switch dedicated to the agent node or automation for its human-assistance setting.
